title: Mohr's Circle Visualiser
summary: Transform a 3D stress or small-strain state and see it on Mohr's circles: principal values and directions by Jacobi rotation, the three circles with the admissible region shaded, and the 2D circle of a rotation about x, y, z or a principal axis with a draggable angle. Plane stress and plane strain, stress- or strain-driven input linked by Hooke's law, true unit conversion, tension- or compression-positive and two shear-sign conventions, Tresca, Mohr-Coulomb, Rankine and von Mises checks with envelopes, a strain-gauge rosette helper and an orbitable 3D element with a cut plane. Step-by-step hand calculations of the transformation, saved or copied as Markdown, JSON and Markdown export and import, a narrated Markdown deck to open in beamdswitch for slides and a video, and a self-test on every load. Runs offline.
